prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Oxygen (산소) itself — the sovereign of the Oxygen Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: breath and fire and rust in one: cool clear air as translucent cloth, bright combustion orange as accents, the quiet power to corrode, the deep blue of oceans and the green of forests; it is the element of life and burning. Palette: sea blue, forest green, clear white, combustion orange.

World (fixed): year 2200, an ocean terraforming station: oxygen-generation towers venting white plumes, coral-glass domes, blue-green plasma light. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a sleek armored bodysuit — thin, long plates on the shoulders, arms and legs that follow her curves closely; 2) large wing-shaped binder plates spread symmetrically behind her back as the main shape, with light body armor; 3) light body armor with several small shield and drone units floating symmetrically around her; 4) a large ring halo behind her head and a tall crown-like head unit, with long hanging shoulder plates — a ceremonial, elegant shape; 5) separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them; 6) one long segmented mechanical tail reaching from the back of her waist, tipped with a weapon or ornament; 7) ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles, with light body armor — the floating rings make the shape. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): sea blue, forest green, clear white, combustion orange.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): ocean-blue hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure: moderate — a fully opaque armored suit with a closed chest plate and covered torso, hips and thighs; only her face, hands and small upper-arm gaps show skin.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (O) and atomic number (8) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Chosen original design: choose silhouette 6, one long segmented mechanical tail from the back of her waist. A different adult woman with a soft round-diamond face, clear pale beige skin, expressive lavender eyes with gently downturned corners, softly arched brows, small rounded nose and peach lips. Ocean-blue hair in a short asymmetrical pixie cut with long sweeping fringe; curious relaxed expression with closed lips. Her whole body reads as armored female mecha: solid clear-white and sea-blue curved hard plates on chest, abdomen, hips, shoulders, forearms, thighs and shins with forest-green inset panels, thick edges, hinges and slim orange glow lines, closed opaque chest armor and small upper-arm articulation gaps. Human face, hair and two ordinary empty hands, five fingers on each. No cloth, robe, skirt or fabric cape. Signature construction: the long rigid segmented tail curls behind and to one side, each segment a paired concave shell like an oxygen molecule's linked spheres; its tip is a compact coral-seeding nozzle with blue-green plasma vents, visibly mounted to her armored pelvis. She stands on a white platform above a terraformed ocean in year 2200, hips turned slightly right, head toward viewer, one open hand lifted beside the waist and the other lowered. Tall oxygen towers release white plumes behind coral-glass domes.

observations: One adult woman, both human hands visible, full body and feet within image; no extra limbs observed.
World and selected design match the displayed candidate. O and 8 occur within scene or costume, no overlay or watermark.
Mecha 4 uses closed chest armor at moderate exposure.

generation.note: Original image retained; only converted to WebP. No regenerated output replaced a successful image.
